candidates.description: This feature vector activates on French demonstrative and possessive determiners and pronouns.
This vector represents personal and demonstrative pronouns across different grammatical cases and languages.
This vector represents French pronouns and demonstrative determiners used to refer to specific individuals, objects, or concepts.
This feature vector activates on tokens related to the concept of existence, being, and related morphological roots across multiple languages.
These tokens represent truncated French words following elided apostrophes (like "l'", "d'", or "qu'").
This vector represents French third-person singular verb forms and suffixes, primarily involving auxiliary and modal verbs.
These tokens represent common French adverbial modifiers of degree, time, and logical relation.
This feature vector represents words and subwords containing or related to the root "-ject" (meaning to throw or cast).
This feature activates on the French indefinite article "un" and "une," as well as similarly spelled subwords and tokens in multilingual or noisy contexts.
This vector represents core importance, essential nature, or fundamental significance across multiple languages.
